name: The Eighteenth Pilot
summary: On the Shimmering Flats, Pozzik sends you to find Razzeric while he works on the racers. Razzeric is the team's eighteenth pilot, and he enjoys modifying the racers.

sections.title: Meet the Pilot
sections.body: Pozzik is fitting a new fuel regulator into the racer designs. He sends you to Razzeric on the Shimmering Flats, the team's eighteenth pilot. Razzeric likes to modify the racers. Pozzik says he is a little off his rocker, so try not to look too surprised.

sections.title: A Pilot Remembers
sections.body: Razzeric knows you have been helping Pozzik. He remembers running around the pit area and pitching in on any job the mechanics let him near. Now he is the goblin racing team's pilot extraordinaire.

faq.answer: Razzeric is a goblin who pilots the goblin racing team on the Shimmering Flats. Pozzik calls him the team's eighteenth pilot.

faq.q: Why does Pozzik send you to Razzeric?
faq.answer: Pozzik is fitting a new fuel regulator into the racer designs, so he sends you to speak with Razzeric and help the team further.
Pozzik says Razzeric likes to make small changes to the racers and is a little off his rocker.
Before this, you delivered the Fuel Regulator Blueprints to Pozzik in Goblin Sponsorship.
